$comment: DESIGN.md §17 M1: 'Single-player, one small hand-made arena.' Hand-made, and made of data — the arena is a list of forms and materials placed at coordinates, which is all a place can be in a game with no content database. Every dummy below is the same form; the only thing that differs is what its target slot is made of, and that is the entire lesson the arena teaches.

player.$comment: Not a player type. An entity with a Body, Effectors, Locomotion and Agency, exactly as §6.1 requires — the only thing that makes it the player is that a keyboard writes its Agency.

rack.label: iron sword
rack.note: the dependable one — never breaks, never impresses

rack.label: obsidian sword
rack.note: hardness 8.50, toughness 0.04 — devastating, and it will not survive stone

rack.label: quartz sword
rack.note: light and vicious, and it melts at 45 degrees

rack.label: meteoric sword
rack.note: hard AND tough — the anomaly of §7.4, and it simply never breaks

rack.label: iron dagger
rack.note: tiny contact area, fast recovery, real work against metal

rack.label: iron spear
rack.note: reach 2.4 and enough stress to go through plate — at the point's risk

rack.label: iron axe
rack.note: between the sword and the maul, and severs limbs

rack.label: iron maul
rack.note: cannot dent chitin and shatters it anyway; barely bruises flesh

rack.label: lead maul
rack.note: past the mass optimum: heavier, slower and worse in every way

props.$comment: A forge that is genuinely cooling. There is no fuel model at M1, so it will drop below 900 and freeze into basalt after a few minutes — which is the honest behaviour and worth watching.
